lines.en: Iron feet. A pit with every step.

lines.zh: 四格高的身体，走进门就卡住。
lines.en: Four blocks tall. I jam in doorways.

lines.zh: 机械的腿走起来有节奏。
lines.en: Machine legs. There's a rhythm to them.

lines.zh: 跟在主人后面，保持三步。
lines.en: Three steps behind my owner. Always.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候头在扫视。
lines.en: My head scans while I walk.

lines.zh: 金属脚底压断了不少草。
lines.en: My metal soles snap a lot of grass.
I'm walking at you. No detours.

lines.zh: 这具身体不喘，也不会慢。
lines.en: This body doesn't pant and doesn't slow.

lines.zh: 关节上有润滑油的味道。
lines.en: The smell of oil on my joints.
Step by step, I close in.
Turning takes the whole leg. Clumsy.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的树枝拨开了。
lines.en: I brush aside the branches in my way.
Even idle, I'm listening.
My claw opens and closes twice.
The red light from my eyes sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我原本的高。
lines.en: This body is taller than my original.
If my owner's here, I just stand.

lines.zh: 机械的声音很小，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My machinery is very quiet. Almost silent.
I fix on a point and don't move.
Rust on the shoulder. It won't come off.

lines.zh: 我在等命令，等不到就自己判断。
lines.en: Waiting for orders. If none, I decide.

lines.zh: 这地方太亮，眼睛有点糊。
lines.en: Too bright here. My optics blur.

lines.zh: 我把头转了半圈，看后面。
lines.en: My head turns half a circle to check behind.

lines.zh: 身后的影子是圆的，不是我。
lines.en: The shadow behind is round. Not mine.

lines.zh: 机器不需要休息，只需要电。
lines.en: A machine doesn't rest. It needs power.

lines.zh: 我听见蜂鸣，是自己发出来的。
lines.en: I hear a hum. It's coming from me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁在你的脸上。
lines.en: My optics are fixed on your face.
You're shorter. I look down.
Are you the target?

lines.zh: 我扫描了一遍你的装备。
lines.en: I scanned your equipment once.

lines.zh: 你在后退，但我已经记住了位置。
lines.en: You're backing away. I've logged the position.

lines.zh: 我的脸不会动，这不是冷漠。
lines.en: My face doesn't move. That's not coldness.
Don't stand in front of my feet.

lines.zh: 我知道你在看我，我不介意。
lines.en: I know you're staring. It doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，这是警告。
lines.en: I raise one hand. That's a warning.
I've measured your heart rate.

lines.zh: 铁的脸上没有表情，看清楚。
lines.en: An iron face shows nothing. Look closely.
Three blocks back. That's protocol.
Standing like that, you look like bait.
I don't blink, so don't wait for it.

lines.zh: 我把注意力全放在你身上了。
lines.en: All my attention is on you.

lines.zh: 你身上有金属，我闻得到。
lines.en: There's metal on you. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 让我看看你手心有什么。
lines.en: Show me what's in your palm.
Calculating your reach.
Hull damage logged.
Thick armor. Still dents.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的动作。
lines.en: That interrupted my sequence.
Something rattled in my wiring.

lines.zh: 我重新计算你的威胁等级。
lines.en: Recalculating your threat level.
No pain. Still costs efficiency.
You hit a seam.
My weight keeps me from dodging.
That one's in the log.
Minor damage. Continuing.
I'm a machine. I don't eat.

lines.zh: 你举食物给我，逻辑不通。
lines.en: Offering food makes no sense.
Does that smell of metal?
Power. That's what I need.

lines.zh: 你晃它没用，我没有食欲。
lines.en: Waving it won't work. I have no appetite.

lines.zh: 我扫描了那块东西，不能吃。
lines.en: I scanned it. Inedible.

lines.zh: 如果你拿的是电池，早说。
lines.en: If that were a battery, you should've said.

lines.zh: 我伸头过去看了一下，没兴趣。
lines.en: I leaned in for a look. Not interested.

lines.zh: 那块铁没有能量，我扫描过了。
lines.en: That iron carries no energy; I scanned it.

lines.zh: 我的反应是程序，不是渴望。
lines.en: My reaction is protocol, not desire.
You hit a steel plate.
My weight is centered. Unmovable.

lines.zh: 碰撞检测到你了，别贴过来。
lines.en: Contact detected. Don't press closer.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，免得压坏你。
lines.en: I'll take half a step back so I don't crush you.
Bet your arm's numb.
A machine body doesn't know yielding.

lines.zh: 我转向另一边，让你过去。
lines.en: I turn the other way. Pass.
A sharp clang. Metal.
Too close. You'll get pinched.

lines.zh: 我脚下有块石头被压碎了。
lines.en: A stone crunched under my foot.

lines.zh: 我的构造里没有这一项。
lines.en: That's not in my construction.
My master never installed a heart in me.
I don't understand what you want.

lines.zh: 别贴过来，我的外壳是冷的。
lines.en: Don't press close. My shell is cold.
No social module in my routines.
I follow. I don't keep company.
All you'd touch is iron.
Step back. Better for both of us.

lines.zh: 如果主人来了，我会挡住你。
lines.en: If my owner comes, I'll block you.
Request denied.
I pick it up and scan it.
Purpose unknown.
Storing it in an interior slot.
So small I nearly missed it.

lines.zh: 金属可以回收，这个不行。
lines.en: Metal is recyclable. This isn't.
I hold it to the light.
The claw's a bit tight. Don't rush me.
Something on the ground. Taking it.

lines.zh: 这不是主人的，但归我管。
lines.en: Not my owner's. Still my business.
Filed under miscellaneous.
Target confirmed. Moving.

lines.zh: 那么大一台机器，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Such a big machine; I grind forward.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，我不会看错。
lines.en: There is one target, and I will not mistake it.
Scan complete. Weakness: the legs.

lines.zh: 你是敌人还是障碍？都处理。
lines.en: Enemy or obstacle? Either way.
A red dot settles on your chest.

lines.zh: 我的底盘开始压过来了。
lines.en: My chassis is bearing down.

lines.zh: 你举武器的动作有点慢。
lines.en: That weapon raise was slow.
I don't detour when I chase.
You're in the corner. Good.
I judge you a threat.
I won't miss this time.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，很快结束。
lines.en: One target. It'll be quick.
My pace is increasing.
Target confirmed. Engaging.
Behind the tree. I'll come around.

lines.zh: 我不跑，只用走就能追上你。
lines.en: I don't run; walking is enough to catch you.
Every retreat is logged.

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，但不会停。
lines.en: Not fast. Never stopping.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住铁。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop iron.
Calculating how many hits you'll take.
The red light follows you.

lines.zh: 四米一的机器人，站着就挡路。
lines.en: A four-meter robot blocks the way just by standing.
My joints are warm now.

lines.zh: 你呼吸声变了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing changed. I hear it.
My shadow has you framed.
You circle. I take the straight path.

lines.zh: 距离三格，进入攻击范围。
lines.en: Three blocks. Within attack range.

lines.zh: 没有支援，也没有第二次机会。
lines.en: No backup. No second chance.
My claw is open.

lines.zh: 我的脚印压塌了草，正朝你来。
lines.en: My footprints flatten the grass, heading for you.
Two more steps and I'm there.
I've already run your escape route.

lines.zh: 一时停不下，就这样冲过去。
lines.en: Can't brake in time. Going through.
The claw snaps shut. Got you.
One punch and you're two steps back.
Body check. Simplest option.
The iron arm sweeps. Wind arrives first.

lines.zh: 我一拳下去，你的肩甲瘪了。
lines.en: My iron fist lands, and your pauldron caves in.

lines.zh: 我钳子夹住肩甲，抬离地面。
lines.en: My pincers clamp your shoulder plate and lift you off the ground.
No allowance made there.
My fist doesn't tire.
This iron shell aims for the feet.
You down. Task complete.
I'm holding you down. Stop struggling.

lines.zh: 机械的声音在你耳边响。
lines.en: Machinery whirs by your ear.
You retreat. I advance.
That strike used full power.
Your knees are giving.
Target lost combat capability.

lines.zh: 我站起来，铁皮互相摩擦。
lines.en: I stand. My plates grind together.

lines.zh: 四格高的身体，出现在你门口。
lines.en: Four blocks tall, at your door.
Boot complete. My eyes light.

lines.zh: 我被放在了地上，然后开始动。
lines.en: Set down on the ground, then I moved.

lines.zh: 我扫描了这片区域，记住出口。
lines.en: I scanned the area. Exits logged.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥土被我的重量压实。
lines.en: The soil packs under my weight.

lines.zh: 主人不在，我就自己找目标。
lines.en: My owner's gone. I'll find targets myself.
My startup sounded like a door opening.

lines.zh: 这么高的铁架，你们没见过吧。
lines.en: A steel frame this tall. Unusual?

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I raise an arm. The joints click.
My gaze passes you and pauses.
I straighten up, then choose a direction.

lines.zh: 这身体比我记得的更重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than I remembered.

lines.zh: 我从土里被挖出来，然后醒了。
lines.en: Dug out of the earth, and then I woke.

lines.zh: 铁在地上拖出长长一道痕。
lines.en: Iron leaves a long scar on the ground.
I hear breathing nearby.

lines.zh: 指令很模糊，但方向很清楚。
lines.en: The orders were vague. The direction is clear.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，地面凹下去。
lines.en: First step. The ground dips.

lines.zh: 外壳开始发烫，散热不够。
lines.en: The shell is heating. Cooling can't keep up.

lines.zh: 落地时腿部的缓冲失效了。
lines.en: Landing. My leg dampers failed.
Water in my ports. Movements slowing.

lines.zh: 冲击把一块装甲掀开了。
lines.en: The blast peeled off an armor plate.
A round lodged in the armor gap.

lines.zh: 这种攻击没有物理来源。
lines.en: This attack has no physical source.
Power nearly out. Shutting down soon.
Overload. My whole frame shakes.
Falling. Gravity still applies to machines.
